FXTILE.Enabled: Fill this Tile with an FXMaster effect
FXTILE.HideImageHint: The effect replaces the image or video. Untick to keep the image visible under the effect.
FXTILE.Hint: The effect fills the Tile's rectangle with a hard edge and is drawn at the Tile's elevation, just above the Tile itself. Use the Tile's Elevation and Sort to layer it between other tiles.
FXTILE.NoFXMaster: FXMaster Tile Effects: FXMaster is not active, so tile effects are disabled.
FXTILE.OldFXMaster: FXMaster Tile Effects: this FXMaster version is older than 7.3.0. Effects may spawn outside their tiles. Please update FXMaster to the latest 7.x.
